name: What is the typical cost range for an accessible kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for an accessible kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an accessible kitchen remodel can vary widely, generally ranging from $25,000 to $75,000 or more, depending on the extent of modifications, material choices, and the size of the kitchen. Key factors influencing cost include appliance selection (e.g., smart, height-adjustable), custom cabinetry, structural alterations for improved access, and specialized fixtures. Hometelligent Inc. offers detailed estimates after an on-site assessment to align the design with your budget and accessibility needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for accessible kitchen remodels typically range from $25,000 to $75,000+, depending on project scope and materials.
